title: docs(pm-dispatch): every card carries a business rationale the 分诊席 judges, every card is triaged (pre-applied labels are a suggestion), and a seat verifies a card's premise before dispatch
body:

_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DUiuRwAvJHZThcC1wdYPpPe)_

Fixes #25507

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读(草稿)

- **改了什么**:把您 2026-10-23 16:43–16:45Z 的三句话写进 pm-dispatch:①「我说的是业务需求上的合理性,谁来判断」+「立卡」⇒ 立卡门从三答变四答,多一栏「业务理由」(谁受益、什么场景、不做会怎样);分诊首触先读它,三个出口:清楚且合北极星方向 ⇒ 照常定级入队;缺失或站不住 ⇒ `Triage: returned` 退回立卡人补,卡留 `finding`、不入队,分诊 ⛔ 不代写、⛔ 不因此关卡;涉及产品取舍或方向不明 ⇒ `needs-user-decision`,由总监席按批呈您;批量立卡(一次 ≥10 张)审计评论带 `Batch-of:`,总监席每源抽 ≤5 张给您过目。②「分诊应该所有卡都分诊,因为有的车道在立卡的时候就打上了标签」⇒ 预贴的标签只算建议,`pm:queue`/`priority:*` 只由分诊首触落笔;与建卡同分钟出现的队列/级别标签视作未分诊;无分诊审计评论的卡不是候选、不得认领;skills 车道「finding 自分诊」的例外撤销;单车道仓(hotcrm 等)席位自己做的首触也含业务理由。③「并且立刻派发」所批的派发前核实 ⇒ 席位派发前起只读子代理核实前提(卡线程卡在交候选之前做):成立 ⇒ 派;不成立但改法明确(目标不变,只换落点或修法)⇒ 评论记改法与读数、改正文,再派;判不了 ⇒ 入决策箱,不占卡线程槽;砍范围、降级、关卡仍是卡的命运,归人工地板。
- **为什么改**:现状没有人判断需求合不合理,卡的来源写什么就当什么;卡线程发现前提不成立时已经占了一个名额。两条都是您 16:43Z 起在项目聊天里点的。
- **风险与代价(含回滚)**:纯规则文本;`filing-gate.md` 64→68、`dispatch-runbook.md` 241→245 两处抬上限引您的原话,其余七个文件就地改、行数不变;人工决裁底线(`triage-duties.md` 末 26 行)逐字节未动;一次 revert 可回。要您知道的三处:(a) 本 PR 改写了 #25422 一分钟前落地的一行「半标卡归所属车道席补齐」,析取 ③④ 回到分诊席,依据是您 16:44:57Z 的原话,不是静默覆盖;(b) SKILL.md 域车道「例外二」(自贴标签且三件齐 ⇒ 执行席直接认领)被撤,它不是批 #3 保留的那条「例外二」(那条是门禁翻 report-only,原文未动);(c) 应用仓没有分诊席,业务理由由仓席自己在首触里读,立卡人与判断人可能是同一席,您若要独立一眼,得把分诊席扩到应用仓,那是另一张卡。
- **席位意见**:席位契约复核两轮,首轮 6377274688 唯一 FAIL(全预贴卡没有 sweep 人口)已修,次轮 6377468190 在 head c9dae42 上 **PASS**,CI 47 项全绿;复核同时提醒:应用仓无分诊席(上面 (c))、`Premise:` 行未进 SKILL.md 认领模板(一行后续)、卡 #25490 派发前应重读正文(其六项中两项已被本 PR 做空)。
- **你要做的(一个动作)**:无。您 14:14Z 已在 Skills 席位线程授权「后续按 pm-dispatch 规则审核通过的都可以落地」;复核已 PASS、CI 全绿,现受您 2026-10-24 00:00Z「准备发版本,暂停合并新的pr」约束,解冻后由席位落地。

## What changed

Nine files: eight rule-text files under `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**` and two ceiling rows in `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`. Every edited rule line is at or under 120 bytes.

| File | Before | After |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `references/filing-gate.md` 立卡门 (64 → 68) | 「POST 前正文答三件:类别 ①–④、动手的读者、查重查询与命中数(含 closed)」; ③ and ④ on two lines | 四件 (类别、业务理由、动手的读者、查重查询与命中数); +5 lines: the field (who benefits, the scenario, the cost of not doing it; ③ answers with the maintainer's words, ④ inherits the parent; triage never writes it for the filer), the three triage exits (clear and on the North-Star direction ⇒ queue; missing or not holding ⇒ `Triage: returned`, card kept `finding`, re-read after the body changes, never written for them and never closed on it; a product trade-off or unclear direction ⇒ `needs-user-decision`, the 总监席 presents it), and the batch rule (≥10 cards at once ⇒ `Batch-of:` on the audit comment, the 总监席 samples ≤5 per source to the maintainer). Paid in place: ③ and ④ merged onto one line (110 bytes) |
| `references/triage-duties.md` (103 → 103) | 析取 ② only; 「有 `domain:*` 无 pm-state,或 … 无 `priority:*` 的半标卡,归所属车道席补齐」 (#25422); 「自贴卡抽查:…同分钟,逐张核车道、补齐三件」; 「skills 车道 finding 由该席自分诊,全仓轮跳过」; pointer 「三答与配额见 filing-gate.md」 | 析取 ③ and ④ back on the triage seat with ②'s two-minute window; L17 「析取 ⑤:窗内新建且 `pm:queue`/`priority:*` 与建卡同分钟,照未分诊首触;⛔ 不凭 actor」 (the same-minute rule with its own sweep population; review fix `c9dae42` after FAIL-1 of 6377274688; the 「预贴标签只是建议」 clause lives in `SKILL.md` L172 and `execution-duties.md` L9), L19 五析取 sweep; 「每张卡欠一次分诊首触,车道 ⛔ 不自分诊」; +1 line 「首触先按业务理由三出口分流,再定级路由;批量卡审计评论带 `Batch-of:` 行」 after the pointer, which now names 四答 and 理由判据; paid by merging 「分类动作每张三选一…」 with 「裁定写方向、给六态之一」. Lines 78–103 (裁决恒归维护者人工, 人工地板, 风险判据, 工作量判据, 不呈, 例外一/二, 请示纪律) are byte-identical to `main` |
| `SKILL.md` 域车道 (318, in place) | 「例外二:立卡人自贴而车道合上表、正文齐立卡门三件 ⇒ 执行席直接认领,分诊事后抽查」 | 「预贴标签只是建议,队列与级别只由分诊落笔(例外一同承);无分诊审计评论 ⛔ 不得认领」 |
| `references/execution-duties.md` 候选 (in place) | 「自贴 `domain:*` 卡:合域表且齐立卡门三件 ⇒ 候选;缺一 ⇒ 挂 `pm:retriage`」 | 「无分诊审计评论的卡不是候选,预贴 `pm:queue` 视同无;例外一的 sub-issue 承父卡首触」 |
| `references/lanes/triage.md` (in place) | 「范围 = … 的裸卡首触(定级、路由、三件)…」 | 「范围 = objectstack、objectui 每张卡首触(业务理由与定级)与跨车道查重;应用仓无分诊席」 |
| `references/lanes/skills.md` (in place, 2 lines) | 「唯一例外:本车道 finding 自分诊,全仓轮跳过」 + the 仪器 question asked by the self-triage | the lane's findings take the triage seat's first touch like every card; the seat may attach evidence and its answer to 「仪器为车队服务」; a finding with no answer ⇒ the seat suggests p3 or not doing it, ⛔ never queues it itself; the grade stays with triage |
| `references/cross-repo-coordination.md` (in place) | 「机械三务 = 自扫 sweep、自打 `type`、自做 `finding` 首触定级」 | 「… 自做首触(含 `finding` 与业务理由,判据评论同分诊)」: a single-lane repo's seat reads the business rationale in its own first touch and leaves the same audit comment |
| `references/dispatch-runbook.md` (241 → 245) | 「## subagent 批派发前置:先把本地检出钉到 main」; 「sweep 析取①②」 | heading renamed in place 「## 派发前置:前提核实,再把本地检出钉到 main」; +4 lines at its head: the read-only subagent at the floor tier, run for a card-thread card before the candidate is handed to the coordinator; the three exits (holds ⇒ dispatch; false with a clear fix ⇒ correct the card then dispatch; cannot judge ⇒ decision inbox, no card-thread slot); 「改法明确 = 目标不变,只换落点或修法」 with the comment that records the old premise, the reading and the change before the body edit; scope cuts, downgrades and closes are the card's fate on the human floor, and the reading lands on a `Premise:` claim line. 「析取①–⑤」 in place |
| `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` | filing-gate.md 64, dispatch-runbook.md 241 | 68 and 245, each row's comment quoting the maintainer's word and the measured delta; neither file is a `CROSS_FILE_MOVES` participant. `triage-duties.md` is the declared source of the director.md move (120 → 103), so its ceiling is not raised: its one new line is paid in place |

Acceptance reads on this head: `git grep -n '例外二' -- .claude/skills/pm-dispatch` → one hit, `triage-duties.md` L92 (the report-only valve batch #3 kept); `git grep -n '自分诊' -- .claude/skills/pm-dispatch` → two hits, both ⛔ lines; `git grep -n '三件' -- .claude/skills/pm-dispatch` → 出处三件 lines and `filing-gate.md` L30 「可推三件」 (the three answers triage may derive; the business rationale is the one it may not); `git diff main -- .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/triage-duties.md | grep '^[-+]' | grep -c '人工地板\|风险判据\|工作量判据'` → 0.

The two raises are ordinary ruled raises under the ratchet header's maintainer exit: the ruling of record is the maintainer's word of 2026-10-23 quoted verbatim on card #25507 (「我说的是业务需求上的合理性，谁来判断」, 「立卡」, 「并且立刻派发」, 「而且分诊应该所有卡都分诊，因为有的车道在立卡的时候就打上了标签」) and in the seat's claim, comment 6370029859 (corrected by 6370094728); measured deltas +4 and +4, each row moved by exactly that. Paying them by deletion was tried first: every bullet pair in both files that would merge under 120 bytes was measured, one merge per file was available and both were taken; the remaining lines are the rule text the word orders. Widest edited line 120 bytes (`filing-gate.md` 四件 line).

## Gates

On head `c9dae42` (the rule commit `7a21474`, the `main` merge `2ab989f` that brings #25474 and #25506 in, which touches `execution-duties.md` and `dispatch-runbook.md` in hunks this PR's diff does not, and the review fix `c9dae42` for FAIL-1 of contract review 6377274688: a card filed with `domain:*` + `pm:queue` + `priority:*` in the same minute matched none of disjuncts ①–④, so `triage-duties.md` L17 now names 析取 ⑤ 「窗内新建且 `pm:queue`/`priority:*` 与建卡同分钟,照未分诊首触;⛔ 不凭 actor」, L19 五析取, `dispatch-runbook.md` L64 析取①–⑤, all in place, 103/103 and 245/245 held), each exit code captured before any pipe:

- The four the card names: `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` ✓ (self-test green; `filing-gate.md` 68/68, `triage-duties.md` 103/103, `dispatch-runbook.md` 245/245, `SKILL.md` 318/318, `execution-duties.md` 188/188, `lanes/triage.md` 7/7, `lanes/skills.md` 32/33, `cross-repo-coordination.md` 51/51; the director.md move still reads +17 against its source's −17), `pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint` ✓, `pnpm check:skill-frame-sync` ✓, `pnpm check:skill-frame-freshness` ✓. Also `pnpm check:pm-governed-prose` ✓ and `node scripts/check-commit-card-trailers.mjs --range origin/main..HEAD` ✓, all re-run after the `main` merge.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack <the nine changed paths>` derives 52 commands (the ratchet script's path pulls in the `scripts` roster families). After `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`: **47 × exit 0; 3 × exit 2** (`check-closing-target-claim`, `check-partof-closing-keyword`, `check-single-claim-paths`: usage exits, they read a PR number or body from CI's environment; `check-partof-closing-keyword` re-run with this body as `PR_BODY` exits 0); **2 × exit 3** (`check:dts-closure`, `check:published-readme-exports`: PREREQUISITE, they read built `dist/`, which this card's text does not touch and this thread did not build). CI's check-runs on this head are the record either way.
- No published package moves (`.claude/**` and one ceiling file), so `skip-changeset`.

## Ordering and open PRs

- Built on `main` after #25422 (card #25414) and #25474 (card #25457) landed; `main` merged in at `2ab989f` (clean, no conflict). #25474's hunks (`execution-duties.md` 派发 L121–L130, `dispatch-runbook.md` 〈卡线程〉 L140) and this PR's (`execution-duties.md` L9, `dispatch-runbook.md` L64 and L149–L153) do not touch.
- Card #25490 (queued, five stale triage lines in `seat-post-protocol.md`, `seat-lifecycle.md`, `cross-repo-coordination.md` L7) shares `cross-repo-coordination.md` with this PR; this PR edits L10 only.
- The claim's file surface was widened by comment 6370094728 to the three in-place lines the 「所有卡都分诊」 rule needs (`execution-duties.md` L9, `lanes/skills.md` L22–L23, `cross-repo-coordination.md` L10); nothing outside the widened surface is touched.

## Acceptance notes

- **Supersedes one line of #25422 and one of batch #3's untouched context, on the maintainer's later word.** #25422 (landed 16:46Z) sent the half-labelled disjuncts ③④ to the owning lane seat; the maintainer's 16:44:57Z sentence orders every card through triage, so ③④ return to the triage seat and the 自贴卡 spot-check becomes the rule. SKILL.md 域车道 例外二 (self-labelled ⇒ direct claim) is withdrawn for the same reason; it is not the `triage-duties.md` 例外二 (the report-only valve) that batch #3 item 1.2 kept, which is byte-identical. Both are said here so the reviewer can hold them against the word, not discover them.
- **The `Premise:` claim line is prescribed in the runbook but not yet in the SKILL.md claim template** (318/318, no line in the file merges under 120 bytes). The claim-reading gates read only `Branch:`/`Clause-②:`/`Metadata-protocol:`, so an extra line is legal today; the template line is a one-line follow-up for the seat when SKILL.md next has a line to pay.
- **Single-lane repos have no triage seat** (`cross-repo-coordination.md`, #25422): their `repo:*` seat reads the business rationale in its own first touch, so filer and judge can be the same seat there. Named in the 速读 for the maintainer; widening the triage seat to app repos would be its own card.
- **A returned card is kept `finding`**, the label the state model already defines as 「待首次定级」, instead of a new label: it keeps the card out of the queue and the inbox and inside the finding round, which re-reads it only after the body changes. `sweep-stale-finding.mjs` strips `finding` only from cards that already carry a grade, so a returned card is never swept.
- The body's first line is the HTML-comment attribution block the project session requires; `os-dev.md` 〈干净收尾〉 forbids HTML comments in GitHub text. Reported as a deviation, not hidden.
- The commit carries the model-free trailer pair the pre-push hook requires and no card trailer; the card relation is this body's `Fixes` line only.
- Opened through the fleet-write relay `pr_create`, so the author is `objectstack-fleet[bot]`; every later write to this PR goes through the relay too.
- Governed surface `.claude/**` (Tier S): draft, awaiting the seat's `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review; landing by the seat under the maintainer's 14:14Z standing word in the skills seat thread; ⛔ not to be flipped ready, queued or armed by this thread.
